subject: Visitor credentialing and delegation protocol — Praxis Labs exec workshop
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@praxis.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Visitor credentialing ahead of July 21 Praxis exec workshop

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for hosting us for the July 21 executive workshop. To make the day run smoothly for both teams, can you confirm Praxis's visitor credentialing and delegation requirements? Specifically we need: 

- Names and roles of the 12 Redwood attendees (we'll attach a roster in the next email)
- Whether Praxis requires sponsor escort beyond badge pickup (full-day escort vs. lobby escort)
- Any PII/phone restrictions for onsite devices or rooms
- Timing for badge pick-up (window) and acceptable ID forms

We're attaching an access roster template and our proposed delegation matrix (temporary on-site delegates for sponsor approvals). If there's a preferred security POC or a portal we should register in, please point us there and we'll get everything uploaded.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can finalize travel and check-in logistics from our side.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Program Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0194

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@praxis.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: praxis-security@praxis.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Visitor credentialing ahead of July 21 Praxis exec workshop

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — happy to confirm. A few notes from security: 

- Badge pickup is at the main lobby from 07:30–09:30 on the workshop day. Lead sponsor must bring government-issued photo ID for everyone.
- We require a single sponsor per external organization; sponsor must be a Praxis staffer and will be responsible for short-term escorts only. No full-day escorts required for vetted partners.
- Devices with cameras are allowed in public spaces but not in the executive briefing room; phones may be used in breakout areas only.
- Please have attendees complete the Praxis partner access form (attached) and sign the on-site NDA. Minimal background checks are performed for contractors; enterprise partners are exempt with a sponsor attestation.

I've attached the partner access form. For registration please upload completed PDFs to vendors.praxis.com/access (secure portal link below). Our onsite security lead is Tom Hargreaves (tom.h@conferencevenue.com) who manages badge printing and will escalate any exceptions.

Quick ask: can Redwood nominate an on-site delegate list (2 people max) who can approve emergency exceptions (e.g., extended equipment access)? We need names + mobile numbers to whitelist them with security.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Events Program Manager, Praxis Labs
Samantha.Lowe@praxis.com

Attachment: praxis_access_form.pdf (stub)
Link: https://vendors.praxis.com/access

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Visitor credentialing ahead of July 21 Praxis exec workshop

Soojin / Neha,

Thanks — copying the Praxis guidance into our ops checklist. Proposal below:

- Redwood sponsor: Marcus Lin (primary) + Neha Kapoor (delegate). Both will be on-site from 07:00–17:00.
- Pre-arrival: Soojin to upload completed praxis_access_form.pdf for all attendees by July 12.
- On arrival: Marcus or Neha will present IDs, collect badges, and be point-of-contact for any on-the-fly exceptions.
- Device rules: We'll set a 'no cameras' policy in executive briefing slides and label the room as restricted. Breakout rooms will be fine for phones.
- Exceptions: For equipment requiring extended access, Marcus will complete the equipment request form and authorize via DocuSign if Praxis security requests it.

I attached a short delegation matrix for signatures. Can you confirm if Marcus + Neha are acceptable to Praxis (Samantha), and I'll trigger the DocuSign approval once we have final names and mobiles.

Thanks,
Marcus
